cue: When Sunday's post-game exit rite is done.
displaces: Part of the Sunday drift window.
first_session: Twenty-five minutes drawing whatever is on the table in front of you.
note: Lowest cost of the three and aimed at the week's weakest hour. Do not promote it at the same time as anything else — one at a time is the whole method [FRANKLIN-AUTO].
slot: Sunday evening, after the early bell
